It provides enterprise-grade capabilities for data storage, processing, foundation model hosting, orchestration, or governance. Understanding when to select Amazon S3 over competing services is a frequent target of high-scoring exam questions.
tasks.notes: Role: Storage Exam Tip: Choose Amazon S3 whenever you need native, fully managed AWS capability for Storage workloads with zero server administration. Gotcha: Deploying an unmanaged self-hosted EC2 software package when Amazon S3 offers a fully managed, scalable native AWS solution.
